data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 微服夜市的平民小吃
data.description: 王都繁华下町的夜市摊位长廊，蒸汽弥漫。偷偷溜出王宫的阿蕾克希亚双手捧着刚出炉的平民热狗大口咬下，脸颊鼓鼓，红眸闪烁满足。
data.location: lively cobbled food market alley with steaming open-air stalls and paper lanterns
data.action: sitting on wooden bench along street, taking a big bite of a warm street-food roll, cheeks puffed out cutely, glaring playfully sideways
data.lighting: 摊位蒸汽灯光与金黄暖路灯
data.promptProse: Alexia in an oversized casual hoodie sits at a bustling night food alley taking a hearty bite of hot bread, cheeks puffed with a tsundere blush.
data.animaCaption: Warm food-stall steam drifts by as she munches on street food with puffed cheeks.
